value.rationale: The example shows a qualitative failure of the necessity of strict pointwise average expansion for an atomic stationary distribution: a whole negative-log-slope parameter interval still has geometric denominator-depth recurrence. The problem is naturally motivated by the exact sufficient condition of the originating paper. The nonconstant finite-prefix Lyapunov construction is structurally nontrivial, not a table recomputation or arbitrary subcase.
